The test image shows a very young soybean seedling collapsed on moist/wet soil. Key features:
- Tiny seedling with two cotyledons — one yellowish-tan (dying), one still greenish
- Stem appears wilted/rotted at the soil line, seedling lying flat
- Wet, dark soil conditions

This matches classic **pre/post-emergence damping-off**: seedling fails to stand, collapses near the soil surface. The Pythium damping-off reference collage shows nearly identical scenarios — very young seedlings with cotyledons on wet soil, collapsed stems, same appearance and growth stage.
